title: Soil
examples: What are the different parts of soil?
How do we know what kind of soil we have?
Can soil be made to grow food?

explain.say: Today we are learning about soil, which is the material that covers the Earth's surface.
Soil has different layers, just like a cake with many levels.

draw.text: Soil Layers: O, A, B, C

explain.say: The O horizon is the very top layer, full of dead leaves and sticks.
The A horizon is the topsoil, which is dark and rich in humus.

draw.text: A Horizon: Topsoil, rich in humus

explain.say: Humus is the dark, crumbly material made from decaying plants and animals.
Soil matters because it holds the nutrients plants need to grow big and strong.

faq.q: What is the difference between topsoil and subsoil?
faq.a: Topsoil is the uppermost layer, rich in humus and nutrients. Subsoil is the layer beneath it, which is usually less organic.
asks: Is topsoil the same as the A horizon?

faq.a: Humus forms when dead plants and animals break down over a long time. This process is called decomposition.
asks: What is the dark, crumbly stuff in soil?

faq.q: Do all soils look the same?
faq.a: No, soils can vary greatly depending on the climate and what grows there. Some are sandy, some are clayey.
asks: Are all soils good for farming?

faq.q: Which layer is best for growing vegetables?
faq.a: The A horizon, or topsoil, is generally the best layer because it contains the most humus and nutrients for roots.
asks: Should I plant seeds in the O or A layer?
Which layer has the most life?

faq.q: What is the deepest layer of soil?
faq.a: The C horizon is the deepest layer, which is usually made of partially weathered rock material.
asks: What is below the B horizon?

facts: Soil is made up of weathered rock, organic matter, water, and air.
The O horizon contains fresh, undecomposed plant matter.
Humus is the key component that gives soil its dark color and fertility.
The A horizon is the layer where most plant roots are found.

quiz.say: Which layer is primarily made of dead leaves and twigs?
quiz.why: The O horizon is specifically where fresh, undecomposed organic material like leaves collects first.

wrong.0: The A horizon is the topsoil, which is already mixed with humus, not just fresh leaves.
wrong.1: The B horizon is where materials from above are washed down, not the initial layer of leaves.
wrong.2: The C horizon is mostly weathered rock, not fresh plant debris.

quiz.say: What is the dark, crumbly material that improves soil?
quiz.why: Humus is the stable, dark material formed from the decay of all organic matter.

wrong.0: Water is a liquid that fills the spaces in the soil, it is not the decayed material itself.
wrong.1: Topsoil is the name of the layer, but humus is the specific material that makes it rich.
wrong.3: Minerals are the inorganic parts, like sand or clay, not the decayed organic matter.

quiz.say: If you dig deep, which layer is mostly weathered rock?
quiz.why: The C horizon represents the parent material, which is rock that has started to break down.

wrong.0: The B horizon is where materials are deposited, but it is not primarily the original bedrock.
wrong.2: The A horizon is the very top layer, which is rich and dark, not mostly rock.
wrong.3: The O horizon is only made of surface debris like leaves and twigs.
